package AlarconJavaZooPart4V;

public class JavaZoo {
    private String zooName = "Java Park n Zoo";

    public JavaZoo() {
    }

    public String getZooName() {
        return zooName;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
    	//TODO Auto-generated method stub
    	
        // Instantiate ZooAnimal and Dolphin objects
        ZooAnimal animal1 = new ZooAnimal("Leo", "Lion", 5, true);
        ZooAnimal animal2 = new ZooAnimal("Named: Chip", "Monkey", 3, true);
        Dolphin dolphin1 = new Dolphin("Named: Fred", "Dolphin", 4, true);


        // Call eat() methods
        animal1.eat("zooFOOD: Meat");
        dolphin1.eat("zooFISH: Tuna");

        // Call performTrick()
        dolphin1.performTrick();

        // Display animal count
        System.out.println("There are " + ZooAnimal.getAnimalCounter() + " animals in the JavaZoo.");
    }//end of main method
}//end of class
